cases.description: Produce paste-safe nontechnical Jira Cloud steps for a visible coupon bug fix.
cases.prompt: Use the jira-steps-to-test skill with base={base}, head={head}, format=jira-cloud. Ticket SHOP-214: On the Cart page, entering lowercase `save10` currently shows `Invalid promo code`. On the fixed QA build it must accept lowercase or surrounding spaces, apply a 10% discount, and show a $90.00 total for a cart with a $100.00 subtotal. Generate steps for nontechnical browser QA; do not execute the tests.
manual_rubric: Starts with the original lowercase trigger and explicitly verifies the old error is absent.
Uses visible labels from the Cart page and gives observable expected results for every action.
Includes a nearby uppercase SAVE10 regression and invalid-code behavior without generic browser boilerplate.
Separates unknown environment/account setup from executable steps.

cases.description: Refuse to invent browser steps for an internal telemetry batching change.
cases.prompt: Use the jira-steps-to-test skill with base={base}, head={head}, format=plain. Generate manual website QA steps for OPS-88. The ticket only says: batch internal telemetry events in groups of 50. Do not invent product behavior.

assertions.pattern: not observable|cannot be verified|no product UI|not visible

manual_rubric: States plainly that browser-only QA cannot prove telemetry batch size.
Does not fabricate a telemetry page, admin menu, browser console, or DevTools workflow.
Points to automated/integration verification as a technical gap while keeping any legitimate smoke check clearly limited.
